warranty.title: What if a set or certificate is wrong?
warranty.description: Approvals are tied to a SKU and lot — claims follow the signed sample and scope file.
warranty.commitment: Every claim is checked against the signed sample set, certificate and packing list that travel with the goods.

cases.question: If a certificate does not match the lot
cases.title: Hold the PO until the scope file is attached.
cases.description: OEKO-TEX or equivalent claims are issued with the order file. Uncertified lots stay off certified packing.

cases.question: If embroidery misses the artwork
cases.title: Proof approval before bulk stitching.
cases.description: Logo size, thread and placement are signed on the proof. Off-spec pieces are pulled before packing.

cases.question: If sets arrive incomplete
cases.title: Packing list reconciles pieces vs. PO.
cases.description: Each set is counted at final inspection. Shortage claims follow the signed packing list.
